findings.issue: Sensitive business values still live in Flowable process variables; the T-0721 gate now PDP-protects them, but the least-sensitive-by-design fix (keep variables minimal — correlation keys only) is a separate hardening follow-up. Out of phase-1 scope.
findings.suggestion: Track T-0714 §7 п.4 as a follow-up: audit emit-sites so business truth stays in the (gated) record and Flowable variables carry only id/correlation keys.

findings.issue: FF-INST-VIS-1b/1c greps the substring `isInstanceDetailVisible(`; a superstring rename of the call (e.g. BYPASSED_isInstanceDetailVisible() slips past the FF. Verified live: FF-1 PASSed when the call was renamed to a superstring. Not a product hole — a superstring is an undefined symbol that tsc rejects — but the fitness detector is weaker than intended.
findings.suggestion: Tighten the grep to a word boundary (e.g. `(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])isInstanceDetailVisible\(`) so only the real call token matches.

findings.issue: Timing side-channel: the denied-DETAIL path does +3 DB round-trips (getGrantsForSubject + loadTenantOrgAncestry + loadRecordRowAncestry) before its 404, whereas a genuine not-found 404 (no projection match) returns immediately. This discloses whether an instance exists in the tenant. Harmless in phase-1 because LIST already discloses instance existence wholesale (acknowledged scope).
findings.suggestion: When T-0722 gates LIST, revisit this DETAIL timing channel — otherwise it will re-disclose the existence of a hidden instance that the LIST gate is meant to hide.

findings.issue: Live-PG matrix uses only the default-open RESOURCE_ROOT grant. It does not prove (a) a narrow record-scoped grant covering record X makes instance-of-X visible while instance-of-Y returns 404, nor (b) a revoked/expired grant (valid_until in the past) returns 404 on the instance path. Both are covered transitively by the reused isRecordReadable and its records-read-pdp suite, but not proven on the instance path here.
findings.suggestion: Add two live-PG cases: a record-scoped narrow grant (visible-X / 404-Y) and an expired grant → 404, to harden the instance-path proof.
